environment.serialization: Compile and measurement processes share /tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock. CPU affinity, timers, commands and raw samples are recorded per group.

changes: After the existing small-reachable probe fails, select a new increasing-index initial relaxation only for bounded-size graphs whose start has one forward outgoing edge.

Cache the current vertex distance once per row. A non-improving backward edge can be ignored; an improving backward edge triggers ordinary continuation unless the unique-path negative-cycle certificate applies.

On ordinary continuation, move the already initialized distance vector without reinitializing it. Fuse validation-state recovery into existing source collection; mark only reached vertices strictly before the stop vertex. The partially checked stop row and initially unreached past vertices remain unchecked.

While every previously processed reached row has at most one outgoing edge, a finite backward target is an ancestor. If it improves, its path back to the current vertex certifies a negative cycle; propagate -INF through reachable edges instead of further Bellman-Ford passes. The current vertex may be the first branch; the uniqueness flag is cleared after its row.
Use an empty parameter pack for ordinary calls to retain the three-argument ABI; only seeded continuation receives the pointer and stop state.
Use false_type instead of an unused vector when Warm=false, removing small-graph stack initialization and restoring its performance.

proofs.fixed_point: Only forward destinations are updated during the initial pass. Every processed source therefore keeps its distance. On success every reached edge satisfies d[to]<=d[from]+w with final source and target values; all reached distances are valid walk lengths, proving exact shortest distances and absence of reachable negative cycles.
proofs.cycle_certificate: Before the first branch, all finite visited vertices form the unique increasing path from start. A finite destination at or before the current vertex lies on that path. candidate<d[target] makes the closed path weight negative. Current-row forward branches are all reachable from this cycle. BFS from the ancestor marks exactly cycle-influenced vertices and checks downstream input while propagating.
proofs.guards: The initial pass is used only if n*1e9<INF; its finite prefix paths use at most n-1 edges and the candidate at most n, so every addition is safe and finite values cannot collide with INF/-INF. Larger n uses the existing arithmetic-protected implementation.
proofs.complexity: Existing O(VE+V+E) time/O(V) space retained. Initial pass and immediate negative propagation are O(V+E). Small reachable probe is unchanged. Ordinary continuation uses at mostn-1 existing passes from valid finite upper bounds.
proofs.input_guarantees: Only reached outgoing edges are validated; unreachable malformed components are not inspected. In checked mode all calculations use temporary storage and input exceptions preserve the original output. In skip mode input validation and its dedicated state are preprocessed away; mathematical guards remain.
proofs.seeded_checked_state: For vertex<stop, a finite initial distance means that row was completely processed, since no backward improvement was applied. The stop vertex itself can be partially processed and remains unchecked. Initially unreached past vertices also remain unchecked and are validated if a later back edge reaches them.

spfa.decision: adopted for Clang with Small=false only
changes: Only Clang Small=false compiles direct advancement inside the existing single-outgoing-edge branch.

If the ring is empty and relaxation improves an unqueued destination, return that destination and resume vertex processing without writing/reading the ring. State, distance, and path length are read again.
FIFO order is identical: direct advancement is only used when no other queued item exists. Non-improvement, negative influence, and n-edge detection keep their original behavior.
Multiple-edge processing has no runtime pending variable, pending test, or additional queue allocation. O(V) space and all existing input/overflow protections remain.
GCC uses no Direct implementation; Clang Small=true instantiates only the old relaxation and ring handling. No compiler extension is used by the fast path.

adopted_changes.change: small==1/2の最適点切替境界を既存positive.cached.pへ保存し照会で使う
adopted_changes.effect: 追加メンバーなしでtree nodeへの参照を1段減らす。k/mと同じrefresh時にpを代入。
adopted_changes.invariant: small1/2の活性包絡が変わればrefresh_hintが呼ばれる。refresh省略を許す挿入はsmall==3だけ。small==3の境界比較はlive tree pのまま。未採用・包絡不変挿入では境界不変。コピーはrefresh、移動・swapはnode所有とキャッシュ値を同時移転、clearはヒントを初期化する。
adopted_changes.limitation: Clang max単独tinyなど全呼出側で最速にはならない。混在max/minと実交互を含む比較で選択。

adopted_changes.change: GNU/Clangのキャッシュ・inline/coldヒントをFORCE_PORTABLE数学backend指定から分離
adopted_changes.effect: FORCE_PORTABLEは標準整数算術の代替を選ぶ。GNU/Clang向け配置・ヒントは引き続き使う。その他処理系には既存のcache_points=falseと属性なしの分岐を残す。
adopted_changes.limitation: FORCE_PORTABLE指定時のsizeofが256→592B。通常版は592→592B。その他処理系のcache無効表現は別の計測対象ではなく、テストコピーで正しさを検証。

adopted_changes.change: max_optional/min_optionalに既存方式の条件付きalways_inlineを付加
adopted_changes.effect: 4構成のoptional専用関数callは2箇所→0。中間版で発生したoptional照会の後退を解消。
adopted_changes.source_delta_from_intermediate: メソッド2個の前に各3行のGNU/Clang属性ガードのみ。API、分岐、戻り値、算術は不変。

line_containers.numerical_safety: 範囲・有限性・商のoverflow・相殺を伴う積和の保護は維持。SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKSは入力検査のみ除く。1D整数算術のnative/標準代替は変更しない。
